nodes.name: Manual run - one historical date
nodes.notes: Manual UI runs use the defaults in Run configuration. No schedule exists.

nodes.name: Controlled webhook run
nodes.notes: Controlled evidence runs only. Header-authenticated, no schedule, deactivated after the run.

nodes.name: Run configuration
nodes.notes: One morning or a bounded batch of up to 40 mornings, one validation label. Defaults to both challenger versions on 2024-01-10.

nodes.name: Fetch committed panel
nodes.notes: Reads the same checked-in run-v1.json the local controller reads. No provider or warehouse read.

nodes.name: Select one saved morning
nodes.notes: The dataset decides whether each morning exists. One item per requested date; a missing date is passed as a null session so both children return an explicit block.

nodes.name: Bind challenger v0
nodes.notes: Binds this branch to usd-layer1-challenger-v0 before the child is called; one child run per requested morning.

nodes.name: Bind challenger v1
nodes.notes: Binds this branch to usd-layer1-challenger-v1 before the child is called; one child run per requested morning.

nodes.name: Run Challenger v0
nodes.notes: Separately versioned Layer 1 workflow pinned to usd-layer1-challenger-v0.

nodes.name: Run Challenger v1
nodes.notes: Separately versioned Layer 1 workflow pinned to usd-layer1-challenger-v1.

nodes.name: Gather both child answers
nodes.notes: Waits for both versioned children before any pairing. The two branches never race into the combiner.

nodes.name: Compare the two decisions
nodes.notes: Pairs the two child outputs per morning and returns one record per date. It never re-scores a child result, never invents a missing one and never selects a winner from performance.

nodes.name: Return paired record
nodes.notes: Returns both execution links, the input-availability gate, both decisions, four results per model and separate reproduction labels.

parameters.content: Research only. Calls two separately versioned frozen Layer 1 challenger workflows through the same contract. Reads one committed historical panel, writes no warehouse row, places no order and publishes no live call. Manual and controlled-webhook triggers only; no schedule.
